A '''nauga''' was a type of livestock that could be found on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. [[Slopewing]]s or [[thak]]s could be used to herd naugas, as [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] did in [[farm school]].<ref name="XRS" /> Ranches raising the animals could also be found in [[Hollowtown]] on [[Centerpoint Station|Centerpoint Station.]]<ref>[[Suns of Fortune]]</ref>
